title: Rootline walkthrough: Design Studio in depth
description: A clickable walkthrough of a designer's work in Rootline's to-scale Design Studio: an address becomes a site model, an offline iPad site visit, beds and a flagstone walk with base specs, plants from the regional Plant KB with live validation, a sun study and 3D growth, lighting and irrigation layers, a live takeoff pushed to an estimate, options and versions, client markup, a plan set, a change order after the sale and the as-built handoff.
